# definednet_network (Resource)

Manages a network. The API key needs the `networks:create`, `networks:read`, `networks:update`, and `networks:delete` scopes.

A network must have no hosts before it can be deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "definednet_network" "main" {
  name                  = "Management"
  description           = "Ops team management network"
  ipv4_cidr             = "100.100.0.0/22"
  lighthouses_as_relays = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name, 1-255 characters.

### Optional

- `curve` (String) Certificate curve: `25519` or `P256`. Defaults to the API's choice. Changing it forces a new network.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `disable_managed_lighthouses` (Boolean) Opt out of the managed lighthouse. Only set this if you run your own lighthouses. No effect on cert version 1 networks.
- `ipv4_cidr` (String) IPv4 prefix for the network, e.g. `100.100.0.0/22`. Omit for an IPv6-only network. An IPv4 prefix can be added to an existing IPv6-only network, but once set it cannot be changed or removed without replacing the network.
- `lighthouses_as_relays` (Boolean) Configure the network's lighthouses, managed or self-hosted, as relays for hosts that cannot connect directly.

### Read-Only

- `cert_version` (Number) Nebula certificate version in use. Version 2 is required for IPv6.
- `cidrs` (List of String) Every prefix assigned to the network. IPv6-capable networks always include a generated IPv6 prefix.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 form.
- `id` (String) Network ID, e.g. `network-ZJOW3QUQUX5ZAVPVYRHDQUAEIY`.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the owning organization.
- `signing_ca_id` (String) ID of the certificate authority signing host certificates for this network.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import definednet_network.main network-ZJOW3QUQUX5ZAVPVYRHDQUAEIY
```
